rules.description: An independently stated state predicate is required at every observed step.
For each fully observed trigger, forbid earlier responses and require a response in the inclusive step window; inspect overlap and pending windows separately.
Require a state predicate over all modeled disturbance choices within the declared finite scope; no margin optimization is implied.
Retain eventual response as an unbounded obligation; finite completion evidence cannot prove it.
Preserve a source requirement without inventing an executable behavioral interpretation.
Retain a recognized exact scalar bound with its quantity identity, units and applicability context; this is consistency evidence, not a temporal controller proof.
